description: Calculate a pay raise: the new annual and hourly pay, the raise per year, month and biweekly paycheck, the raise as a percentage, and whether it keeps up with inflation. Give either raise_percent (a percentage raise on current pay) or new_pay (the new pay, from which the percentage is worked out), and the pay as per year or per hour. Use hourly_to_salary instead to convert between pay periods without a raise, and us_paycheck_take_home for take-home pay after tax. All amounts are before tax.

current_pay.description: Current pay in US dollars, per year or per hour according to pay_unit.

hours_per_week.description: Hours worked per week, to move between hourly and yearly pay (52 weeks a year). Default 40.

inflation_percent.description: Expected yearly inflation as a percentage, to show the raise in real terms. Default 3.7 (US CPI-U, 12 months to September 2026).

new_pay.description: The new pay in US dollars, per year or per hour according to pay_unit. Give this or raise_percent.

pay_unit.description: Whether current_pay and new_pay are per year or per hour. Default year.

raise_percent.description: The raise as a percentage of current pay, for example 4 for 4%. Give this or new_pay.

name: salary_increase

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Salary increase (pay raise)
